This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory


When milliseconds matter, shotgun loading gets creative. The twin load method lets 3-gun competitors stack shells and ram two rounds into a tube magazine simultaneously—using what shooters call the "violin position." It's physics meets competition. Discover how competitive shooters turned tedious reloading into an edge. #simplehistory
